newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The government postponed its meeting scheduled for Thursday to discuss revising the 1997 budget. Data required for the debate were incomplete. The meeting was rescheduled for Friday.

* Gheorghe Funar, the mayor of Transylvanian city of Cluj, had asked through an open letter to Foreign Ministry to remove the Hungarian flag from Hungary consulate opened in Cluj last week. Funar also demanded the consulate's closure.
* Crime had increased in recent, Romania's General Prosecutor told a news conference.
